title: Expedited permits for Lahaina and Kula rebuilds
summary: At the latest meeting, a testifier urged using fiscal year 2028 and rainy day funds to speed permits in Lahaina town and to put utilities underground. Earlier, in April 2025, a contractor working through Public Works was helping planning review West Maui building permits. The planning director said the department reviews each Lahaina building permit and looks closely at shoreline projects.
